channel.title: Zambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Zambia, every source cited.

item.title: Nkana and Power Dynamos fined K100,000 each
item.description: The Football Association of Zambia sanctioned two clubs for political slogans at matches.

item.title: Zambia launches presidential irrigation pilot
item.description: Five schools in Kaoma District will each cultivate one hectare of maize under the new programme.

item.title: Zambia raises fuel prices for November
item.description: Petrol, diesel, and kerosene costs increase due to global oil prices and Kwacha depreciation.

item.title: Zambia plans orderly urban growth
item.description: Vice-President Nalumango says urban planning must improve services without displacing people.

item.title: UTH water project reaches 70 percent completion
item.description: The K69.7 million project aims to ensure reliable water supply and prevent infections at the hospital.
